evidence.observation: H701 reads 442.9 °C while H702 reads 70.1 °C and the reboiler vessel reads 71.0 °C; a large heater-temperature discrepancy persists throughout the observations.
T701 reaches 453.5 °C while T702 is 69.9 °C and T703 is 72.1 °C.
T701 drops to 429.0 °C in one minute while T702 is 69.3 °C and T703 is 72.2 °C; actual heater overheating versus a measurement fault remains unresolved.

System pressure is 500.6 mbar, column differential pressure 0.6 mbar, buffer differential pressure 2.8 mbar, cooling-water flow 5.9, and both product and reflux flows zero; no corresponding pressure excursion is evident.

args.missing_evidence: H701 operating setpoint and safe temperature limit, heater power/output status, and an independent heater-temperature measurement are needed to distinguish actual overheating from sensor or readout error. Composition measurements and the separation target are required to assess separation performance.
